description.text: Application Time each year before the end of June Term begins each year on September (follow the Enrolment Notice) Accomodation If you need dormitory on campus, room reservation should be made when application. If dormitories are full, we don't accept any room reservation.

duration.text: The Pharmaceutical Chemistry at Tianjin University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK A minimum requirement of HSK 3 or 6 (liberal arts) certificate. 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.Undergraduate school transcript 5.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 6.Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents

requirements.text: 1.An equivalent of China’s college education; 2.Final education certificate and transcript; 3.Over 18 years in age; 4.A minimum requirement of HSK 6 certificate; 5.Recommendations from at least two teachers with titles of/or above associate professor;
